content:
rachael: heads up: planning an EU->NA residency handoff for ~40 tenants tomorrow. want a slim runbook and abort gates. this is active/active -> promoted-primary cutover.

matt: solid. do we still use lease-swap + prewarm standby? worried about transient fallback storms.

jyoti: yes. canonical flow: kv-snapshot -> prewarm -> canary -> lease-swap -> promote. add consent-check read and checksum validation after promote.

sam: operational checklist (short):
- verify legal consent flag for each tenant (natalie)
- ensure KV snapshot for tenants present in region bucket
- prewarm standby pools with weights + snapshot
- canary 1% for 10m, watch p50/p95 and 5xx rate

natalie: I will validate consent matrix by 12:00UTC. confirm format: tenant_id, consent:true/false, jurisdiction.

rachael: runbook fragment we should include: 
```
1) run `./tools/kv_capture --tenants tenants.csv --dest s3://eu-archives/$CUTOVER_ID`
2) legal check: `./tools/consent_check --file tenants.csv` -> fail if any consent=false
3) prewarm: `POST /v1/pools/standby?action=prewarm&cutover_id=$ID`
4) canary: route 1% for 10m -> thresholds: errors>0.5% or p95>220ms => abort
5) lease-swap: `POST /v1/leases/swap?tenants=@tenants.csv&timeout=180s`
6) promote standby -> `POST /v1/pools/promote?cutover_id=$ID`
7) post-validate: sample 100 keys -> checksum mismatch >1% => alert+rollback
```
(matt: we should script 1/2/3)

matt: for step 5, are we checking controller aggregate leases or per-proxy? last incident showed controller lag.

jyoti: rely on controller aggregate + verify per-proxy heartbeat for high-risk tenants. add a safety TTL (lease_ttl) of 3m; if leases not zero, trigger auto-abort.

sam: add inflight heuristic: if inflight_requests > 500 for any tenant after prewarm, hold canary. queueing cascades yesterday were scary.

rachael: add consent-stamp freshness check: routing must read `consent_stamp_ts` and require age < 24h. if stale, block.

infra-bot: deploybot: Cutover plan created: cutover-1746543210 by rachael. Canary window scheduled 2026-03-25T14:00Z.

natalie: also: for GDPR tenants, confirm data copyability to NA. if not allowed, exclude from tenants.csv.

matt: rollback steps we should include explicitly: 
```
# abort/rollback
POST /v1/pools/standby?action=drain&cutover_id=$ID
POST /v1/leases/revert?tenants=@tenants.csv
update-router --set X-Resident-Region=eu --apply
```

jyoti: post-cutover probe: sample embeddings and KV keys. compute checksums and semantic-sanity (50 random prompts -> embeddings distance compare). threshold: checksum mismatch >1% OR semantic drift >0.12 => rollback and page SRE.

sam: add `cutover_id` metadata to all logs/traces/metrics during the operation. makes dashboards and traces filterable. also add X-Cutover-ID header for request tracing.

rachael: agree. action items:
- rachael: draft runbook + preflight script (will include abort conditions and env vars)
- matt: review script 09:30 tomorrow
- jyoti: implement checksum + semantic probes
- natalie: consent matrix validation and exclusion list
- sam: add cutover panels to monitoring dashboard

matt: tiny nit: include a dry-run flag in tools so we can validate orchestration without flipping live routing.

rachael: will add `--dry-run` to scripts. pushing draft to `docs/runbooks/cutovers` today. please comment. :eyes:
